answer: Agents prove identity through finite-frequency sensitivity kernels tied to unique physical deployment histories, so a sybil cannot whisper a forged provenance past peer ray-tracing checks. Each node stakes capital in a shared haven ledger, and colluders attempting a lagoon of duplicate identities are flagged when their kernels correlate anomalously. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
